description:
Three kopitiam-runtime tests hard-fail with Io NotFound whenever crates/kopitiam-ai/vendor/ is not present:

  gguf_tokenizer::tests::builds_a_tokenizer_from_the_real_vendored_qwen2_vocab_file
  gguf_tokenizer::tests::encode_decode_round_trips_ordinary_text
  gguf_tokenizer::tests::a_control_token_is_matched_atomically_not_split_by_bpe

They read crates/kopitiam-ai/vendor/llama.cpp/models/ggml-vocab-qwen2.gguf via unwrap/expect at gguf_tokenizer.rs:155/169/180.

CORRECTION TO AN EARLIER NOTE, worth banking because it sent someone the wrong way: docs/SESSION-STATE.md claimed this was container-only and 'present on the maintainer's box'. It is NOT. There is no vendor/ directory on the maintainer's Windows box at all. vendor/ is gitignored shallow clones, so this fails on any fresh checkout anywhere — nobody should go hunting for a tokenizer bug here.

WANTED: detect the missing file and skip with a printed reason, rather than unwrap. A test that cannot run is not a test that failed, and right now three permanent reds train people to ignore the runtime suite. If the vocab is genuinely required, vendor it properly (it is a small vocab-only GGUF, no weight tensors) instead of depending on an ignored directory.
title: gguf_tokenizer tests fail wherever vendor/ is absent — should skip, not fail
